entities.name: COQ4-like query protein
observations: 151-aa sequence has Pfam Coq4 domain PF05019 at residues 38–135 (i-Evalue 2.2e-34).
Top Swiss-Prot homolog Q05B52 is 97.1% identical over 90.7% query coverage; homolog annotations support COQ4 role in ubiquinone biosynthesis.

entities.name: Q05B52 COQ4
observations: Reviewed Bos taurus mitochondrial ubiquinone biosynthesis protein; annotated as a lyase catalyzing decarboxylation during ubiquinone biosynthesis.
Located at the mitochondrial inner membrane and part of a multi-subunit COQ enzyme complex; annotated for ubiquinone biosynthetic process.

entities.name: Ubiquinone biosynthesis
observations: COQ4 homolog annotations associate the protein with ubiquinone (coenzyme Q) biosynthesis.
